question: Which of the following publishes the Red List of Threatened Species?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IUCN**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature)** is a membership Union uniquely composed of both government and civil society organizations.
 
• Created in **1948**, IUCN has evolved into the world’s largest and most diverse environmental network.
